answer: Each epoch, the network pairs every vertex in the trust graph with a random peer and orders a mutual audit: each agent must inspect its partner's recent work and either vouch for it or report it, while a falcon auditor swoops on any report to verify it, and a bounty rewards the first truthful report of a clone. A farm's clones must either vouch for each other — risking joint slashing when a zephyr of spot-checks catches one — or betray their siblings to keep their own stake, so every new clone adds a mouth that can defect. Honest agents vouch freely; a farm collapses from within.
